indigo-bolt.$description: Indigo Bolt — Violet action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Orange accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis

lime-highlighter.$description: Lime Highlighter — Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases.

lavender-mist.$description: Lavender Mist — Soft card surface, gentle section background — pastel variant for breaking up the white canvas without adding noise

ice-blue.$description: Ice Blue — Cool pastel card surface, section wash — pairs with indigo to reinforce the primary brand hue at low intensity

lilac-bloom.$description: Lilac Bloom — Saturated card background in feature card grid — bolder pastel, one of four colored card variants that rotate across feature rows

deep-navy.$description: Deep Navy — Blue wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

forest-sage.$description: Forest Sage — Muted teal card variant — grounded, earthy counterpoint in the four-color card rotation

warm-bone.$description: Warm Bone — Secondary canvas, soft section backgrounds, neutral action borders — the off-white that keeps the page from feeling sterile

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Page background, card surfaces, button fills, body text on dark sections

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, dark feature sections, filled dark comparison cards — creates the dramatic black bands that make the colors pop

hairline.$description: Hairline — Borders, dividers, table rules, input borders — the workhorse neutral stroke

stone.$description: Stone — Mid-gray strokes, subtle dividers, muted icon backgrounds

smoke.$description: Smoke — Secondary body text, helper text, muted captions

graphite.$description: Graphite — Tertiary text, button labels on neutral buttons

regular.$description: Regular — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

a-geometric-grotesque-sans-serif-custom-.$value: A geometric grotesque sans-serif (custom-marketed as the site font — Inter
a-geometric-grotesque-sans-serif-custom-.$description: Inter, Manrope, or DM Sans are close substitutes) — All UI, body, navigation, and headings. Weight 500 carries buttons, nav links, and sub-headings; weight 400 owns body copy; weight 700 reserved for eyebrow labels with opened tracking. The full range from 11px captions to 150px display headings makes this a single-family system doing everything.

nanum-pen-script.$description: Hand-drawn personality accent — appears only under hero copy (the orange 'actually work' underline) and similar signature moments. Never used for body, UI, or navigation. This is the brand's most distinctive typographic move: a script that says 'we're human, not enterprise software'.
